items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 9:1
items.html: The NHY of Atik, which became the garments of the Mochin of Arich Anpin, are divided into the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK of Tzelem: the aspect of the MEM in them are the thighs above the Yesod, which are clothed in the two ears, and they always remain in the aspect of Avir, for from them the Yud does not go out of the air. And the aspect of the LAMED in them are clothed in the two eyes, being the aspect of the thighs below the Yesod, called the revealed NHY of Atik — that is, in them the Hassadim are revealed, for in Gadlut the Yud goes out of their air and they become the aspect of light, as is known. And it is the sixth correction of the seven corrections of the Galgalta, called 'the open supervision that does not sleep and guards always.' For after the Yud went out of the air and the eyes were opened with the illumination of Hochma, they remained so permanently; and this is what it says, 'that does not sleep and guards always.' But in ZA this correction does not operate permanently, for the Mochin of Gadlut are not fixed in it. And this is the secret of the prayer, 'Open Your eyes and see, etc.,' which is to draw this correction into ZA. (Page 334, Item 84).
